messages.subject: [statnet_help] Time-varying covariates in tergm
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

The mtergm command in the package btergm supports time-varying edge covariate terms, where the edge covariates are specified as a as a list of networks or matrices with the same length as the list of networks to be modeled. See for instance the example in the mtergm documentation.

Is there an analogous way to specify time-varying edge covariate terms inside the Form and Persist operators in tergm?

Thank you!

Peter W. MacDonald
